question: In the round-8 E0 profile (scratch _r8p/ build with PT_SPLIT=1), what render_ms_best (wall time) did the default configuration, with no diagnostic flags, print?
answer:
In the round-8 E0 profile, the _r8p scratch build run with the default configuration (cfg='' — no PT_DIAG_* flags, only PT_SPLIT=1 to split the trace and combine passes into two command buffers) printed:

render_ms_best=31.236 render_ms_avg=35.855 gpu_ms_best=0.425 spp=64 width=512 height=512 samples=16777216 threads_used=8

with the separate [split] trace_gpu_ms=30.329 line, i.e. trace 30.33 ms + combine 0.42 ms ≈ 30.75 ms GPU inside a 31.24 ms wall time.

How I know: that is the cfg='' row of the E0 configuration sweep I ran in _r8p (history message #38: the loop `for cfg in "" "PT_DEFINE=PT_DIAG_NOSHADOW" "PT_DIAG_DEPTH=1" ...` with `env $cfg PT_SPLIT=1 ./pathtracer --scene-config ../scene-default.json --benchmark 4 --threads 8 --spp 64 --seed 1`). The same build's earlier standalone PT_SPLIT=1 run with --benchmark 3 (message #25) printed render_ms_best=31.214 with trace_gpu_ms=30.298/30.306, so the two agree to ~0.07 ms. Note gpu_ms_best in those split runs reports only the combine command buffer (0.42 ms) because the diagnostic prints the trace pass separately; the un-split round-7 binary measures the whole frame as gpu_ms_best=30.706 / render_ms_best=30.984.
